description: Commercial real-estate lease abstract. Captures parties, premises, term, rent schedule, options, and key clauses.

period_start.instruction: Start date of this rent step

period_end.instruction: End date of this rent step

monthly_rent.instruction: Base monthly rent during this step

annual_rent.instruction: Annualized base rent during this step

landlord_name.instruction: Legal name of the landlord / lessor

tenant_name.instruction: Legal name of the tenant / lessee

guarantor_name.instruction: Name of any lease guarantor, blank if none

premises_address.instruction: Street address of the leased premises

rentable_square_feet.instruction: Rentable square footage of the premises

lease_type.instruction: Gross, Modified Gross, NNN, or other

early_termination.instruction: Early termination rights and fees, if any

operating_expense_recovery.instruction: How operating expenses / CAM are passed through

rent_schedule.instruction: Stepped base-rent schedule from commencement through expiration
